beta.notes:
New in this version:
• When RoboSpark work can't be delivered, Buddy offers Check connection, Settings, Try again, Send debug report and Copy details, with advice that fits whether a workspace is open, and a hint when Chrome needs access to its folder.

Fixes:
• On a workspace opened before its first import, students and "See N due" respond when clicked; the learning-period chooser shows its full dates.
• The beach shows behind "+ Add student" instead of a light band.
• Work-date calendar rows are no longer clipped.
• The installer window fits its icons.
